name: orbit
description: Durable tasks, sandboxed parallel runs, and PR-gated delivery for AI coding agents. Adds Orbit's MCP tools and workflow skills to Claude Code.

ownerHost.title: Owner host
ownerHost.description: SSH host or alias of the machine that owns the workspace, for checkouts that are Orbit replicas or not registered here. Empty reads the local workspace only.

refreshMinutes.title: Refresh interval (minutes)
refreshMinutes.description: How often the band and pane re-read the workspace; they also refresh after a turn.

band.title: Band
band.description: The Orbit band above the prompt: full, one compact line, or off.

commitTrailer.title: Task trailer on commits
commitTrailer.description: Add a Task: trailer to git commits made while this session works an Orbit task.
